notes.title: About missing save data after update
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone,

In the latest patch we have updated the game in order to comply with the regulations of some regions and to prevent abuse of the game files, we have updated the game files of this game.

However, this has led to a problem of missing player's save data.
Players who have encountered this problem should change the name of the archive in the game folder as follows:

1. Neighbor Madam_sf.sav > Neighbor_Madam_sf.sav
2. Neighbor Madam_tyrano_data.sav > Neighbor_Madam_tyrano_data.sav

In this way you can retrieve your game data.

Sorry for all the trouble, thank you for your support.

notes.title: 0625 Update
notes.notes:
- Fix the problem that keywords update didn't apply in Traditional Chinese.
- Fix the bug that cause weekday change to "日曜日" when you try to skip the day in End B.(ENG, TCH, SCH ver. )

notes.title: 0624 Update
notes.notes:
Update notes:
- Fix some unnatural text in English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese.
- Adjust keywords in "Message" function in English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese.

Due to the limitation of the game engine, we have to make some compromise on the localization of the Message function. We're really sorry for all the trouble.
And the keywords will be published in the community guide.

Thank you for all the patience and support.
